// Regression fixture for two real bugs found while building CHAOS-5156
// PR2b (both fixed in this PR, since PR2b's own tests caught them first):
//
//  1. Allman-style braces (opening brace on its own line) abandoned the
//     enclosing function declaration entirely -- a bare "\n" token was
//     being forwarded to the state machines when real lizard's own
//     pipeline drops it before they ever see it.
//  2. `#if defined(X)` tokenized as separate "#"/"if"/"defined"/"("/"X"/
//     ")" tokens instead of one directive, so "if" leaked out as a real
//     condition token and "defined(X)" got parsed as if it were a
//     function declaration, corrupting everything that followed until
//     something coincidentally resynced it.
int allman_style(int n)
{
    if (n > 0)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

#if defined(STRICT_MODE)
int guarded_allman(int n)
{
    if (n > 0 && n < 100)
    {
        return n;
    }
    return -1;
}
#endif

int after_guard(int n)
{
    if (n > 0)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
